name: ignition
author: Spacerace Development
browserslist: > 0.5%, cover 90%, iOS >= 13, last 3 versions, not dead

scripts.build-js-prod: parcel build scripts/sections/*.js --no-source-maps --no-cache && parcel build scripts/blocks/*.js --no-source-maps --no-cache && parcel build scripts/snippets/*.js --no-source-maps --no-cache && parcel build scripts/*.js --no-source-maps --no-cache
scripts.build-scss-prod: parcel build styles/*.scss --no-source-maps --no-cache && parcel build styles/components/*.scss --no-source-maps --no-cache
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development && concurrently "parcel watch scripts/sections/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/blocks/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/snippets/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch styles/components/*.scss --no-hmr" "parcel watch styles/*.scss --no-hmr" "shopify theme dev -e dev"
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production && npm run clean && npm run build-js-prod && npm run build-scss-prod
scripts.dev-windows: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "parcel watch scripts/sections/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/blocks/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/snippets/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch scripts/*.js --no-hmr" "parcel watch styles/components/*.scss --no-hmr" "parcel watch styles/*.scss --no-hmr" "shopify theme dev -e dev"
scripts.build-windows: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run clean-windows && npm run build-js-prod && npm run build-scss-prod
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && shopify theme push -e dev
